answer: scaffold_desk (deskops/workspace.py:168) only creates missing files via _write_if_missing (workspace.py:194, :259), so golden_desk/ may hold desk/ content and `desk install` preserves it; install adds only subdirs, config.json, Board.md, pills.md, rituals, drawer/README.md, atoms/tag-namespaces.yaml.

Pattern is defined: tests/test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:36-44 _make_repo does git init -q, user.email/name config, writes seed.txt 'seed\n', add, commit -q -m seed. Commit the seed before adding fixture content.

`closeout commit` never reads the task doc; --task only becomes the Task-Id trailer (deskops/cli/commands/closeout.py:82 and :170). Status gates live in `closeout verify`, not commit, so either fixture task works for either route.

No command creates run dirs: build one by hand under runs/subagents/ with board.txt, task.txt, git-status.txt, result-summary.md (closeout.py:24, :131; pattern tests/test_closeout.py:38-42). index.jsonl is appended by closeout commit itself (closeout.py:96-98, :188-190).
Goldens are produced by the same run, so any fixed reason literal is self-consistent; whitespace is collapsed (closeout.py:64) and nothing else is volatile in the trailer.
`deskops graph reflect --root <root>` is sufficient; --graph is optional and defaults to the root runtime snapshot (deskops/cli/parser.py:331-333).

Those outputs contain no timestamps and only relative paths (snapshot.py:84-98, self_reflection.py:90-116, extract_docs.py:198), so the only volatile value is the commit SHA in run_index.jsonl (full 40 hex, closeout.py:186-106). Normalizing <sha> suffices.

kg.json and self_reflection_findings.json are written json.dumps(indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n' (snapshot.py:113, self_reflection.py:118), nodes sorted by id (snapshot.py:80); .nx.json is indent=2 without sort_keys/newline (../sldb/src/sldb/store/graph/graph_io.py:16). Byte-wise after normalization is stable.
Root `deskops --help` has no command path, so the naming rule does not cover it. Fix: pin the root file name explicitly, e.g. help/_root_.txt, and state that paths are joined with '_' (max depth 2).

Max depth is 2: only parser.add_subparsers at parser.py:32 plus second-level groups (lines 66,114,313,358,382,397,469,571,661,845,870,930,977,1047,1069). No argparse aliases; `inbox` is its own deprecated top-level command (parser.py:498-500).

The snapshot writer is deskops/graph/snapshot.py:113; keys to rename for the manual check are in snapshot.py:19 (SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA) and 84-98 (metadata.schema/extractor/node_count). Any rename breaks the committed golden.

All deps are still undone: every task-rw-f0-* and task-doctor-crashes-on-deskless-roots file in desk/drawer/tasks/ is `status: deferred` (line 3), and desk/tasks/Board.md routes only the operator-manual task.

kg.json/self_reflection: indent=2, sort_keys=True, trailing newline (snapshot.py:113, self_reflection.py:118). run_index.jsonl: one compact json.dumps object per line in literal key order, newline-terminated (closeout.py:100-107, :192-199).
The no-commit rule only forbids committing; editing tracked files in the working tree is the executor's normal output, and the supervisor commits the goldens at closeout.
